claims.statement: Unit tests run tests/unit/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} with Vitest in the Node environment using tsconfig path aliases.
Integration tests run real Payload against Postgres with a global setup, serially across files, with a 30 second test timeout and 120 second hook timeout.
The integration global setup starts the embedded database if needed and resets ta_web_integration when no DATABASE_URL is set, applies migrations with pnpm migrate, and stops any database it started.
Integration helpers start Payload with getPayload, build an in-memory 1x1 PNG, and create and log in a panel user.
E2E servers build the app unless E2E_SKIP_BUILD is 1, reset the E2E database when using the embedded database, run migrations, and start the production server on the configured port.
The E2E config uses port 3100 by default, Chromium only, and in CI one worker, one retry and forbidOnly.
With SMOKE_BASE_URL set Playwright starts no local servers, and basic-auth credentials are used only when both smoke credential variables are set.
The @smoke subset covers the home page, the Payload admin and /api/health.
Outside dev, robots.txt allows indexing except /admin and the home page carries no X-Robots-Tag.
The dev gate suite starts a configured dev instance and a second dev instance without credentials, reusing the build when E2E_SKIP_BUILD is set.
A unit test pins that integration and E2E environments point DATABASE_URL_DIRECT at the test database, and that E2E treats a blank DATABASE_URL as empty.
Unit tests include a quests-collection test that pins the quests collection's field shapes, including the rewards and needs groups, and its access functions.

The integration suite includes tests/integration/migrations.test.ts, which runs pnpm payload migrate:down then pnpm payload migrate with integrationEnv and DATABASE_CONNECTION=direct to check the latest migration rolls back and re-applies.

The DofusDB client unit tests use an injected fake fetch, sleep, log and random, so they check paging, field selection, ID chunking, pauses, retries and errors without reaching the network or waiting.

Unit tests pin quest mapping and the prerequisite rule, and that fetchQuestData looks up by ID only the NPCs and maps named in start positions and the monsters named in needs, while fetching the whole item catalog with the stored fields as its select list.

The refresh-quests integration test runs refreshQuests three times: the first creates the fixture quests and skips missing prerequisites, the second changes nothing and keeps refreshedAt, and the third updates only what changed and links a prerequisite that now exists; a second block does the same for items, monsters, rewards and needs, and the test removes its fixture rows before and after.
DofusDB fixtures in tests/fixtures/dofusdb hold quests, NPCs and map positions shared by the DofusDB unit tests and the refresh integration test.

Unit tests pin the quest-guides collection's fields, versions, autofill hook, validateGuideTitle, validateGuideSlug, validateSlug and access functions, and each guide body block's fields and validateVideoUrl.

The quest-guides access integration test checks that anonymous reads hide drafts and cannot write, that a panel user can publish a draft and get a version, and that a guide with all four body blocks, its linked quest and an image saves and reads back, deleting all guides, quests and media afterwards.
The migrations integration test sets its own 120-second timeout because it starts the Payload CLI twice.

Import unit tests cover page parsing (title, desktop grid order, text, image and unknown blocks), the page-to-guide conversion, HTML to Lexical through Payload's editor, the quest matches CSV and the image download rules.
tests/fixtures/squarespace holds trimmed copies of the five demo Squarespace pages, one HTML file per slug, and Prettier ignores the directory.

The import-fetch-image unit test uses an injected fake fetch to check that the image fetcher refuses http, other hosts, an internal IP, localhost and a look-alike subdomain without making a request, refuses non-image and HTTP error responses, and does not follow redirects.

The import-quest-guides integration test runs the loader on the five fixture pages with a fake fetchImage that returns a 1x1 PNG, checks drafts with blocks, images and the existing quest, one media record per image, oddities, an idempotent second run, one new draft for a changed guide, a summary field that disappears being filled from the linked quest without extra versions on the next run, hidden drafts for anonymous readers, skipping an invalid slug and a guide with several DofusDB IDs saved without a quest, and cleans up its guides, media, quests and item before and after.
The game-data-collections unit test pins the items and monsters slugs, admin settings, field shapes and their use of the shared read-only gameDataAccess.

The quest-rewards unit test checks the level-200 XP and kamas against Torre's and dofusdb.fr's figures, the 1.5x optimal-level cap, per-step flooring, the last reward entry per step, items summed across steps and emote and title IDs.

The quest-needs unit test checks delivered and need.items items, the larger-quantity rule, every fight and soul objective, walksMaps for map and sub-area discovery, and that talking to NPCs, free-form and crafting objectives are ignored.
The game-data-access integration test shows an anonymous request can find and findByID items and monsters, while a panel user gets Forbidden on create, update and delete and the data stays unchanged.
The quests-steps, items and monsters fixtures hold nine quests with steps plus exactly the items and monsters they name, used by the rewards, needs, fetch and refresh tests.

The concurrency unit test checks that mapWithConcurrency keeps input order, never exceeds limit running tasks, runs tasks in order with limit 1, rejects with the first error after running tasks settle without starting more, returns an empty list for empty input, and rejects a limit below 1 or not an integer.
The dofusdb-write-concurrency unit test checks that an empty or unset DOFUSDB_WRITE_CONCURRENCY gives a default below 10, that positive integers are read, and that 0, -2, 1.5 and ocho throw.

A third refresh-quests integration block runs the refresh over both fixtures with concurrency 1 and then with concurrency 8 and expects equal counts and equal stored data, comparing relationships by DofusDB ID.

A fourth refresh-quests integration block feeds the fixture items plus items no quest names, expects every item created with its superTypeId, and expects a second run with the same catalog to write no item and keep refreshedAt.

The items-unreferenced fixture holds three DofusDB items no fixture quest names, a sword of supertype 2 and two quest items of supertype 14, used to test that the whole item catalog is fetched and stored.

The guide-summary unit test builds linked quests from the DofusDB fixtures and checks the generated rewards and prerequisites against Torre's parsed Squarespace pages, the needed items without quest items, the fill rules and every summary note state.
The guide-autofill unit test covers slugFromName, availableSlug suffixes, the SEO templates and 160-character cut, autofillFromQuest never touching written fields, and linkedQuestId.

The quest-guides-autofill integration test saves guides through the local API as a panel user and checks the title, slug, SEO and summary fill from DofusDB, the slug suffix, that written values are kept, the Spanish rejection without title and quest, an imported guide keeping its slug, and an emptied summary field being filled again, deleting every guide, quest and item afterwards.

The needs-list-migration integration test calls the needs_list migration's down and up directly on the migrated integration database and checks that text in the old columns of a guide and its version becomes summary.needs.notes with an empty item list.
The guide-summary unit test checks that requiredLevel gives a level for a PL> joined by & and none for a PL> among | alternatives.

The guide-form-fill unit test checks that plannedFormFill plans every empty field from the quest and nothing for written fields, and that stillEmpty drops fields and a needs list typed during the slug check while still filling what stays empty, treating whitespace-only text and an empty list as empty.
The dofusdb-criterion unit test checks that requiredTerms returns the terms joined by &, nothing from a level with |, the terms inside &-only brackets, and nothing for a null or empty criterion.

The guide-single-quest-migration integration test calls the guide_single_quest migration's down and up directly on a guide linked to one quest, checks after down that the quest is a relation row for the guide and its version, adds a second quest behind it, and checks after up, run in a finally block, that quest_id, version_quest_id and Payload's quest field on the guide and its versions hold the first quest.
appWebServers treats a blank or whitespace-only DATABASE_URL as unset and then uses the embedded Postgres and the ta_web_e2e database.
playwright.config.ts passes E2E_DESIGN_CATALOG=1 to the E2E app server so the production build serves the /sistema catalog during the tests.
tests/e2e/sistema.spec.ts checks the /sistema catalog in every theme and mode, including coordinate copy, hit targets, the video facade, the fullscreen viewer and axe WCAG 2.2 AA checks.
pnpm test:lhci is a sixth suite that runs Lighthouse CI on the production path with its own ta_web_lhci database.
The ui-components and game-components unit tests render the design system components with renderToStaticMarkup and check their markup.
